mars2020:Run_Control_Table_Step.mars2020:comments: sit with everything off collect telemetry
enable motor controller and SOXE power supplies
start motor 1 second prior to SOXE current
Start SOXE current loop at 1.0 A with 4 V offset 55 g/hr 1.0 A for 5 seconds
Enable P4 low limit. 55 g/hr 1.0 A for 1 minute 55 seconds
55 g/hr 2.0A Temp back to normal for 5 minutes
5 minutes of composition sensor data after run

mars2020:Digital_Number_To_Calibrated_Un.mars2020:comments: Evaluate the equations in the order listed

mars2020:Digital_Number_To_Calibrated_Un.mars2020:equation: CU = a((TT_HC - TT_LC)/(TCAL1_HC - TCAL1_LC))^2 + b((TT_HC - TT_LC)/(TCAL1_HC - TCAL1_LC)) + c
CU = a((TB_HC - TB_LC)/(TCAL1_HC - TCAL1_LC))^2 + b((TB_HC - TB_LC)/(TCAL1_HC - TCAL1_LC)) + c
